en.headline: Three sports events receive M Mark status for November and December
en.dek: The Major Sports Events Committee awarded recognition to the Hong Kong Open badminton, FIBA 3x3 basketball and Hong Kong Squash Open.
body: The Major Sports Events Committee has awarded M Mark status to three international sports events scheduled for later this month and early December, the government said on Thursday.

The events are the Li-Ning Hong Kong Open Badminton Championships 2026, part of the HSBC BWF World Tour Super 500, from November 17 to 22; the FIBA 3x3 World Tour Hong Kong 2026 on November 28 and 29; and the Milwaukee Hong Kong Squash Open 2026 from November 30 to December 6.

Committee chairman Wilfred Ng said the badminton event would bring top global players to compete for the championship, the 3x3 basketball would feature fast-paced street contests, and the squash open would offer a strong lineup of world-class players. He noted that the events would enhance Hong Kong's international image and demonstrate its ability to host top-tier competitions. The M Mark system aims to support sustainable major sports events and bring economic benefits to the community.

zh.headline: 三項體育盛事獲頒M品牌認可 涵蓋羽球籃球壁球
zh.dek: 大型體育活動事務委員會向香港公開羽毛球錦標賽、FIBA 3x3世界巡迴賽及香港壁球公開賽授予認可。
body: 大型體育活動事務委員會周四宣布，向三項將於本月稍後及十二月初舉行的國際體育盛事頒授M品牌認可。
有關盛事包括李寧二零二六香港公開羽毛球錦標賽（滙豐世界羽聯世界巡迴賽超級500，十一月十七至二十二日）、FIBA 3x3世界巡迴賽香港站（十一月二十八至二十九日），以及Milwaukee香港壁球公開賽（十一月三十至十二月六日）。
委員會主席吳守基表示，羽毛球公開賽將匯聚全球頂尖選手競逐冠軍，3x3籃球賽再次呈獻節奏明快的街頭對決，壁球公開賽則有世界級球手陣容。他指這些盛事有助提升香港國際形象，並彰顯主辦頂級賽事的能力。M品牌制度旨在推動大型體育活動的可持續發展，並為社會帶來經濟效益。
